title: How Claire Redfield's hunt for Chris ended in Resident Evil
subject: claire
description:
Was Claire the real hero of the Redfield family? 👇

How Claire Redfield's search for her brother ended, from Paris to Antarctica. The story is getting a remake as Resident Evil Veronica in 2027. Spoilers for Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Three months after Raccoon City, Claire broke into Umbrella's Paris lab.
Still hunting for Chris, she was caught and locked up on Rockfort Island by Rodrigo Juan Raval.
A virus tore through the island. Rodrigo freed her, and she met Steve Burnside, a seventeen-year-old prisoner.
She messaged Leon from an island computer, and he got word to Chris.
The trail ended at an Umbrella base in Antarctica, where Steve died refusing to hurt her.
Albert Wesker took her hostage. Chris arrived seconds before the base exploded. They flew out together.
After two outbreaks, Claire had finally found her brother.
